tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on The Crucifixion and Resurrection

questions.question: Q: Explain why the resurrection is important for Christians.
questions.correctAnswer: The resurrection is the cornerstone of Christian faith because: it proves Jesus' divinity — rising from the dead demonstrates power over death that only God could have; it confirms that Jesus' sacrifice was accepted by God, making salvation possible; it gives Christians hope of eternal life — if Jesus conquered death, believers will too; and it transforms the cross from a symbol of defeat into one

questions.question: Q: Explain two ways the crucifixion is significant for Christians.
questions.correctAnswer: 1) The crucifixion brings about atonement — Jesus' death pays the price for human sin, reconciling humanity with God. 2) It demonstrates God's love — that God was willing to suffer the most painful death shows the depth of divine love for humanity, as John 3:16 affirms.
